_comment: Editor layout for the coarse-grained MC structure sampler (ProteinMCModel). The hand-written predecessor hid the sampling settings behind a modal dialog and each energy term's parameters behind a second one; both are tables here, so what a run will actually do is visible without opening anything. The run itself is the general `background_run` section — the model exposes two zero-arg methods and a progress fraction, and the section owns the timer that repaints the trajectory plots while sampling.

sections.label: Structure
sections.placeholder: PDB/PQR path or PDB ID, e.g. 148l
sections.description: The conformation sampling starts from. A PDB ID is fetched; a local .pdb/.pqr/.cif is read as-is. ProteinMC protonates it, so the atom count of a trajectory frame is not the atom count of this file.

sections.label: Labelling
sections.description: FPS JSON holding the labelling positions, the inter-dye distances and the χ² score sets. It supplies the FRET restraints the Dye potential scores against.

sections.label: Score set
sections.description: Which χ² group of the labelling file is scored — it selects the subset of distances used as restraints, and therefore which distances are reported below.

sections.label: Output
sections.description: Where proteinmc.rmf3 and the autosaved project are written. Choosing it before starting is what makes a run resumable.

sections.title: FlexFit
sections.description: Restrict the moving residues to a named set, instead of letting the whole chain move.

sections.label: Use FlexFit
sections.description: When on, only the residues of the selected set move; everything else is held rigid.

sections.label: Set
sections.description: The FlexFit set from the labelling file that defines the flexible residues.

sections.label: Mobile
sections.description: How many residues the active set leaves mobile, out of the residues the labelling file mentions.

columns.label: Term
columns.description: The energy term. Select a row to edit its own parameters below.

columns.label: Eval. every
columns.description: Evaluate this term every N MC steps (1 = every step). Raise it for a term that is expensive and slowly varying.

columns.label: Weight
columns.description: Multiplies this term's contribution to the total energy.

sections.label: Add
sections.description: Which energy term the Add button appends.

buttons.label: ➕ Add term
buttons.description: Append the term chosen above; a term already in the list is not added twice.

buttons.label: ➖ Remove
buttons.description: Drop the selected term (the last one when nothing is selected).

sections.description: The selected term's own parameters. Each keeps the type of its default, so a checkbox setting cannot reach the sampler as the string "True".
kT sets how readily an uphill move is accepted; move scale sets how far one move goes. Max frames caps the trajectory, Save every decides how many MC trials each frame is worth.

options.start_description: Start sampling in the background. A run continues from the frames already in hand rather than discarding them, so a saved project resumes.
options.stop_description: Ask the sampler to stop after the current step.

sections.title: Inter-fluorophore distances
sections.description: Measured on the frame currently displayed — outputs of the structure, not parameters of the fit.
